terra.problem: Calls the baker's selection 'the wrong one,' although Papa never says 'wrong' about an answer.
The statement that chief of the cupbearers is a different officer's title is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation is flat and reads like a generic answer key, with little of Papa's voice.
Saying Potiphar's one job was eating goes beyond the text. It says food was the only thing he concerned himself with among what he entrusted to Joseph.
The explanation is a flat sequence of verse summaries without Papa's distinctive voice.
